name: Arduino Mega 2560 Rev3
record_note: The Mega 2560 Rev3 runs the ATmega2560 at 16 MHz and uses an ATmega16U2 USB-to-serial bridge on Serial0. Board pin constraints, build/flash profiles, and physical-revision confirmation remain open.

onboard_devices.name: ATmega16U2
onboard_devices.function: USB-to-serial bridge for the ATmega2560 target
onboard_devices.notes: The bridge uses Serial0, which is also exposed on RX0/TX0.
